name: L&PBHD
recent: L&P Global 近期宣布拟将业务多元化至快速消费品（FMCG）零售贸易和建筑领域，并通过非关联方交易获得总值约 RM11.76 million 的建筑合约。同时，最新财报（截至2026年6月30日季度）显示营收同比下滑22%，但净利润为 RM3.901 million，净利率26.2%。
notable: 获得总值约 RM11.76 million 的建筑合约。
risks: 公司正在进行业务多元化，进入新领域可能带来执行风险。
最新季度营收同比下滑22%，显示包装业务面临挑战。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为 RM14.896 million，环比下降1.4%，同比下降22.0%；净利润为 RM3.901 million，净利率26.2%，较上一季度的-8.1%转正。

recent_en: L&P Global recently proposed diversifying into FMCG retail trading and construction, and secured construction contracts worth approximately RM11.76 million via non-related party transactions. The company also proposed disposing of a leasehold land and building in Kulim, Kedah. The latest quarterly results (period ended 30 June 2026) show revenue down 22% year-on-year, but net income of RM3.901 million with a 26.2% net margin.
notable_en: Secured construction contracts worth approximately RM11.76 million.
Proposed diversification into FMCG retail trading and construction.
Proposed disposal of a leasehold land and building in Kulim, Kedah.
risks_en: The company is diversifying into new business areas, which may carry execution risks.
Latest quarterly revenue declined 22% year-on-year, indicating headwinds in the packaging business.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM14.896 million, down 1.4% QoQ and 22.0% YoY; net income was RM3.901 million with a net margin of 26.2%, turning positive from -8.1% in the previous quarter.
